import re, json, yaml
text = open('journals/2026-08-18-chaos-mode-503s.md').read()
m = re.match(r'^---\n(.*?)\n---\n', text, re.S)
fm = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1))
import jsonschema
schema = json.load(open('.claude/skills/investigate/journal.schema.json'))
jsonschema.validate(fm, schema)
print('VALID')
print('hypothesis ids:', [h['id'] for h in fm['hypotheses']])
evidence_ids = set(e['id'] for e in fm['evidence'])
print('evidence ids:', sorted(evidence_ids, key=lambda x: int(x[1:])))
refs = set()
for h in fm['hypotheses']:
    refs.update(h['evidence_for']); refs.update(h['evidence_against'])
print('unresolved refs:', refs - evidence_ids)
from datetime import datetime
s = datetime.fromisoformat(fm['investigation']['started'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
c = datetime.fromisoformat(fm['investigation']['concluded'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
print('computed wall_clock_seconds:', (c-s).total_seconds(), 'vs stated', fm['usage']['wall_clock_seconds'])
